notes.classification_isolate_masked_pass_throu: Reads::Every (structure/lookup), not Reachable: the function is a caller-chosen plan rewrite (composite calls it on vector clips/masks), not an admission predicate and not named admit*. It looks up one group layer by index (self.nodes.get(group), g.layers.get(layer)) and counts the layers of every group that reference that layer's input, reachable or not; the count must cover unreachable groups too, because setting the inner group isolated changes it for every reference, so a reachable-only count would let the rewrite alter an unreachable reference silently. It reads no envelope entries and decides no capability: admission still runs on the rewritten plan through the reachable readers already in the table (validate, has_pass_through_mask), so no admission wiring is needed
notes.classification_select_tools: Reads::Every: select_tools::Composite holds &[ColourView] in a field named layers (Self { layers } in new, self.layers in premul) and maxflow's graph has a method nodes() returning its vertex count (add_edge, max_flow, source_side). None touches RenderPlan or PlanExtensions; the scan matches the field names by design (PLR-080) and these rows record that they are not plan readers
